fields.title: 📖 Ibn ʿAbbās: Be Rabbānī
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās** said about the word of Allāh: **“Be Rabbānīyīn”**:

***“Be Rabbānīyīn: people of **Ḥilm** and **Fiqh**.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A Rabbānī is not only someone who carries knowledge. He joins **knowledge** with ***forbearance*** and ***understanding in the Dīn***, so that people are built up with truth — not broken with harshness.

immutable.source: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb al-ʿIlm, Bāb: al-ʿIlm qabl al-qawl wa-l-ʿamal; Aussage von Ibn ʿAbbās in der Kapitelüberschrift, 1/24 bzw. S. 37.
